Daily bars for META, EXPE, GLW and CF: the last 320 rows of Hermes's yfinance cache
(`hermes/.hermes_cache/bars/yfinance/<T>_1d.parquet`, `auto_adjust=True`), copied 2026-10-16.
These are the bars behind the spec's §4 reference trades. Format: `ts` (seconds, the session's
midnight in New York, as UTC), open, high, low, close, volume.
